name: Fenix HM50R V2.0 rechargeable headlamp
summary: A compact rechargeable headlamp for hands-free outage tasks, with white and red light and a removable lamp body. Battery revision and Canadian listing remain to be matched.
description: When the lights fail, a headlamp leaves both hands free to find supplies, read a panel label or move through a familiar room. The HM50R V2.0 suits that role more naturally than broad room lighting. Keep a separate area light for shared spaces and plan charging before an outage. Choose the setting needed for the task rather than treating peak output as an all-night operating level.

pros: Keeps both hands available for low-light tasks.
A detachable body can serve as a small handheld light.
cons: A personal beam does not replace a room lantern.
High output introduces heat and shorter operating time.
Manufacturer pages differ on the included cell and some performance figures; do not mix revisions.
useCases: Read a household emergency checklist while keeping hands available.
Inspect supplies in a dark storage area; carry independent backup lighting.
